correctness.rationale: Directly derived the 6-by-9 coefficient matrix from generic strictly upper triangular matrix multiplication. Four first-superdiagonal support masks normalized under diagonal similarity; the five remaining effective variables give a 16-stratum table, the top-right coordinate contributes q freely. Source symbolic pivot cases separate ranks 0..6 and count all q^5 local fibers for every support. Weighted mask sum gives seven exact polynomials, totals q^10 and pairs sum_R R_r q^(10-r)=q^10(5q^4-5q^2+1). Reimplemented matrix multiplication, field arithmetic and elimination independently, exhaustively checking all normalized higher-coordinate cases for q=2,3,4 and each lambda!=0, with exact rank histograms. Sampling finite fields does not prove all prime powers; generic pivot argument supplies the universal step.

Huang counts unrestricted and semi-nilpotent quantum-plane pairs; fixed simultaneous flag constraints cannot be read off by conditioning only the first matrix. Kobal 2005 canonical forms might encode equivalent information, but complete text unavailable.

value.rationale: A complete arithmetic rank stratification of an intrinsically defined nilpotent flag algebra gives sharp kernel and representation-count information for every q and twist. The exact uniform q-polynomial distinguishes point counts from characteristic-zero component geometry; this is a motivated representation invariant, not a randomly selected finite matrix experiment.

final_claim: For every finite field F_q and nonzero lambda, the exact rank distribution of Y -> XY - lambda YX on strictly upper triangular 5x5 matrices is lambda-independent and yields pair count q^10(5q^4-5q^2+1).
limitations: Both matrices must lie in the specified standard 10-dimensional nilradical, not all nilpotent or upper-triangular matrices.
No proof of geometric irreducibility or corresponding formula for larger dimensions.
